source: Diloloji İngilizce Rehber B1 soru havuzu genişletmesi (15.1h)

gerund_infinitive.prompt: I am really looking forward to ___ you at the conference next week.
gerund_infinitive.why: 'Look forward to' ifadesindeki 'to' bir edattır; arkasından gerund (-ing) gerektirir: looking forward to seeing.

gerund_infinitive.prompt: She decided ___ a new laptop computer instead of repairing her old one.
gerund_infinitive.why: 'Decide' fiilinden sonra mastar (infinitive with to) gelir: decided to buy.

gerund_infinitive.prompt: Would you mind ___ the window, please? It's getting quite cold in here.
gerund_infinitive.why: 'Mind' fiili arkasından daima gerund (-ing) alır: Would you mind closing...?

gerund_infinitive.prompt: He admitted ___ a mistake during the crucial calculation.
gerund_infinitive.why: 'Admit' fiili bir eylemi kabul/itiraf ederken gerund gerektirir: admitted making.

gerund_infinitive.prompt: They cannot afford ___ on holiday abroad this summer due to expenses.
gerund_infinitive.why: 'Afford' fiili ardından to + infinitive alır: afford to go.

gerund_infinitive.prompt: Please remember ___ the front door before you leave for work.
gerund_infinitive.why: Gelecekte yapılması gereken bir görevi hatırlamak 'remember to + infinitive' kalıbıdır: remember to lock.

gerund_infinitive.prompt: I clearly remember ___ my keys on the kitchen table this morning.
gerund_infinitive.why: Geçmişte yapılmış bir olayı hafızada hatırlamak 'remember + gerund'dur: remember putting.

conn_en.prompt: ___ of having a bad cold, she went into the office to finish the report.
conn_en.why: 'Of' edatıyla birlikte kullanılan taviz yapısı 'In spite of'dur; 'despite' yanına 'of' almaz.

conn_en.prompt: ___ the weather was terrible, we enjoyed our camping trip in the mountains.
conn_en.why: Tam bir cümle (özne + fiil) bağlarken taviz bağlacı 'Although' kullanılır.

conn_en.prompt: The company invested heavily in marketing ; ___ , overall sales continued to decline.
conn_en.why: İki bağımsız cümle arasında karşıtlık kuran noktalı virgüllü bağlaç 'however'dır (ancak).

conn_en.prompt: The flight was delayed for two hours ___ severe weather conditions.
conn_en.why: İsim tamlamasından (severe weather conditions) önce neden bildirmek için 'due to' (veya because of) kullanılır.

conn_en.prompt: I wrote down the instructions carefully ___ I wouldn't forget any details.
conn_en.why: Amaç bildiren ve arkasından modal/cümle alan bağlaç 'so that'dir: so that I wouldn't forget.

conn_en.prompt: Peter loves team sports, ___ his brother prefers reading and chess.
conn_en.why: İki durum arasındaki doğrudan karşıtlığı ve tezadı bağlamak için 'whereas' (oysaki) kullanılır.

conn_en.prompt: Take an umbrella with you ___ it rains later in the afternoon.
conn_en.why: İhtimale karşı önlem bildiren yapı 'in case'dir: in case it rains.

prep_en.prompt: Success in life largely depends ___ hard work and continuous determination.
prep_en.why: 'Depend' fiili her zaman 'on' edatıyla kullanılır: depends on.

prep_en.prompt: She has always been deeply interested ___ ancient history and archaeology.
prep_en.why: 'Interested' sıfatı 'in' edatını alır: interested in ancient history.

prep_en.prompt: My brother is exceptionally good ___ solving complex mathematical equations.
prep_en.why: Bir beceride veya alanda iyi olmayı belirtirken 'good at' kullanılır.

prep_en.prompt: He apologized to his teacher ___ being late for the morning lesson.
prep_en.why: 'Apologize for + V-ing' bir şey için özür dilemek anlamına gelir.

prep_en.prompt: Are you afraid ___ spiders and dark places?
prep_en.why: 'Afraid' sıfatı korkulan nesne için 'of' edatı alır: afraid of spiders.

prep_en.prompt: The local residents complained ___ the noise from the nearby construction site.
prep_en.why: Bir durumdan şikayet etmek 'complain about' kalıbıdır.

prep_en.prompt: She is very keen ___ learning how to paint with watercolours.
prep_en.why: 'Keen on' bir şeye çok hevesli ve meraklı olmak anlamına gelir.

colloc_en.prompt: You must ___ an effort if you want to improve your pronunciation.
colloc_en.why: Çaba göstermek kalıbı 'make an effort' şeklindedir.

colloc_en.prompt: We have been studying for three hours; let's ___ a short break.
colloc_en.why: Mola vermek eşdizimi 'take a break' (veya have a break) olarak kullanılır.

colloc_en.prompt: Our international company has been ___ business with Japan for decades.
colloc_en.why: Ticaret yapmak / iş yapmak kalıbı 'do business'dır (make business denmez).

colloc_en.prompt: If you give someone your word, you should always ___ your promise.
Please ___ attention to what the flight attendant is explaining.
It takes a lot of willpower to ___ a bad habit like nail biting.
colloc_en.why: Kötü bir alışkanlığı terk etmek / kırmak 'break a habit' kalıbıdır.

colloc_en.prompt: The research team hopes to ___ significant progress this year.

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «I live in Manchester.» -> Reported: He said that he ___ in Manchester.
reported_speech.why: Raporlayan fiil geçmişte (said) olduğunda Present Simple, Past Simple'a aktarılır: lived.

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «I have lost my passport.» -> Reported: She explained that she ___ her passport.
reported_speech.why: Geçmiş zamanlı aktarımda Present Perfect, Past Perfect'e (had lost) döner.

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «I will call you tomorrow.» -> Reported: He promised that he ___ me the next day.
reported_speech.why: 'Will' yardımcı fiili dolaylı anlatımda 'would' halini alır: would call.

reported_speech.prompt: Sarah ___ me that she was not coming to the party.
reported_speech.why: Kişi nesnesi (me) doğrudan geldiğinde 'tell' fiili geçmişte 'told' olarak kullanılır (said to me gerekirdi).

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «Where do you work?» -> Reported: She asked me where I ___ .
reported_speech.why: Dolaylı sorularda düz cümle dizilimi (özne + fiil) kullanılır ve soru kökü kalkar: where I worked.

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «Please sit down.» -> Reported: The doctor asked me ___ down.
reported_speech.why: Emir ve ricalar dolaylı anlatımda 'ask/tell + nesne + to + infinitive' yapısına dönüşür: to sit down.

reported_speech.prompt: Direct: «Are you ready?» -> Reported: He asked me ___ I was ready.
reported_speech.why: Evet/hayır soruları dolaylı aktarıma 'if' veya 'whether' bağlacıyla bağlanır: if I was ready.

modals_en.prompt: Look at the lights on in his office; he ___ still be working.
modals_en.why: Gözle görülür güçlü kanıta dayalı olumlu kesin çıkarım için 'must' kullanılır: he must still be working.

modals_en.prompt: That story ___ be true! It sounds completely impossible and absurd.
modals_en.why: İmkânsızlık bildiren kesin olumsuz çıkarım için 'can't' kullanılır: it can't be true.

modals_en.prompt: Take a jacket with you; it ___ get chilly later this evening.
modals_en.why: Olasılık ve ihtimal bildirmek için 'might' (veya may/could) kullanılır.

modals_en.prompt: You look feverish; you ___ see a doctor as soon as possible.
modals_en.why: Tavsiye vermek için 'should' kullanılır: you should see a doctor.

modals_en.prompt: We ___ hurry; we still have two whole hours before the flight boards.
modals_en.why: Zorunluluğun olmadığını ('acele etmeye gerek yok') belirtmek için 'needn't' kullanılır.

modals_en.prompt: ___ I borrow your pen for a moment to sign this form?
modals_en.why: Kibar izin isteme ricasında 'May I...?' kullanılır.

modals_en.prompt: You ___ carry that heavy suitcase; ask the porter to help you.
modals_en.why: Kişisel olarak yapmak zorunda olmamak anlamında 'don't have to' kullanılır.

passive_en.prompt: The Mona Lisa was ___ by Leonardo da Vinci in the early 16th century.
passive_en.why: Edilgen çatıda (Passive Voice) 'was + V3' kalıbı kullanılır: was painted.

passive_en.prompt: Millions of text messages are ___ worldwide every single day.
passive_en.why: Geniş zaman çoğul edilgen yapı 'are + V3' şeklindedir: are sent.

passive_en.prompt: The new bridge ___ opened to traffic by the mayor next Monday.
passive_en.why: Gelecek zaman edilgen yapı 'will be + V3' ile kurulur: will be opened.

passive_en.prompt: This classic novel has ___ translated into more than fifty languages.
passive_en.why: Present Perfect edilgen yapı 'has been + V3' şeklindedir: has been translated.

passive_en.prompt: Mobile phones must be ___ during the entire duration of the flight.
passive_en.why: Modal fiillerle edilgen yapı 'must be + V3' kalıbıyla kurulur.

passive_en.prompt: The damaged car is being ___ by the mechanics right now.
passive_en.why: Present Continuous edilgen yapısı 'is being + V3'dür: is being repaired.

passive_en.prompt: The thief was arrested ___ two police officers outside the bank.
passive_en.why: Edilgen cümlede eylemi gerçekleştiren fail 'by' edatıyla bağlanır: by two police officers.

relatives_en.prompt: The woman ___ lives next door is a talented concert pianist.
relatives_en.why: İnsanları niteleyen özne durumundaki ilgi zamiri 'who'dur: the woman who lives.

relatives_en.prompt: The laptop computer ___ I bought last week has a very fast processor.
relatives_en.why: Cansız nesneleri niteleyen ilgi zamiri 'which' (veya that) dir.

relatives_en.prompt: I met a wonderful photographer ___ pictures are exhibited worldwide.
relatives_en.why: Sahiplik bildiren ilgi zamiri 'whose'dur (resimleri dünyaca sergilenen).

relatives_en.prompt: The small seaside village ___ we spent our summer holiday was peaceful.
relatives_en.why: Mekân niteleyen ilgi zamiri 'where'dir: the village where we spent our holiday.

relatives_en.prompt: Do you remember the day ___ we first met at university?
relatives_en.why: Zaman ifadelerini nitelemek için 'when' kullanılır: the day when we first met.

relatives_en.prompt: London, ___ is the capital of the UK, attracts millions of tourists every year.
relatives_en.why: Virgülle ayrılan açıklayıcı (non-defining) ilgi cümlelerinde 'that' kullanılamaz; 'which' zorunludur.

relatives_en.prompt: Everything ___ she said turned out to be completely true.
relatives_en.why: Everything, all, something gibi belgisiz zamirlerden sonra 'that' tercih edilir.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: If it rains tomorrow afternoon, we ___ the picnic in the park.
basics_en_conditionals.why: First Conditional (gerçekçi gelecek) yapısında 'If + Present Simple' sonrasında 'will + V1' gelir: will cancel.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: If I won a million pounds in the lottery, I ___ buy a yacht.
basics_en_conditionals.why: Second Conditional (varsayımsal/hayali) yapısında 'If + Past Simple' sonrasında 'would + V1' kullanılır.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: If you heat ice to above zero degrees Celsius, it ___ . (bilimsel gerçek)
basics_en_conditionals.why: Zero Conditional (doğa kanunu/kesin gerçek) yapısında her iki taraf da Present Simple olur: melts.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: You will miss the flight ___ you leave for the airport right now.
basics_en_conditionals.why: 'Unless' (if not / -medikçe) olumsuz şart kurar: unless you leave (çıkmazsan kaçıracaksın).

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: If I ___ you, I would consult a specialist doctor immediately.
basics_en_conditionals.why: Tavsiye verirken 'If I were you' kalıbı standarttır.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: What would you do if you ___ your passport while travelling abroad?
basics_en_conditionals.why: Second Conditional soru yapısında if cümlesi Past Simple (lost) olur.

basics_en_conditionals.prompt: We will go for a walk in the forest provided that the weather ___ fine.
basics_en_conditionals.why: 'Provided that' (şartıyla) bağlacından sonra zaman kuralı gereği Present Simple (is) kullanılır.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ live in a small village near Oxford.
basics_en_used_to.why: Geçmişteki kalıcı durumlar (live gibi durum fiilleri) için 'would' değil, 'used to' kullanılır.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: On summer mornings, my grandfather ___ sit on the porch and read the newspaper. (geçmiş eylem)
basics_en_used_to.why: Geçmişteki tekrarlanan rutin eylemler için 'would' (veya used to) kullanılabilir.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: Did you ___ play the violin when you were at primary school?
basics_en_used_to.why: 'Did' soru yardımcısından sonra 'used to', yalın hale 'use to' olarak döner: Did you use to play?

basics_en_used_to.prompt: He has lived in London for twenty years, so he ___ the rainy weather.
basics_en_used_to.why: Bir duruma alışkın olmayı belirtmek için 'be used to + isim/gerund' yapısı kullanılır: is used to.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: It took me a long time to ___ waking up at 5 am every morning.
basics_en_used_to.why: Alışma sürecini (alışır hale gelmek) anlatmak için 'get used to + V-ing' kullanılır.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: I ___ like olives when I was younger, but now I love them.
basics_en_used_to.why: Geçmiş durum olumsuzluğu 'didn't use to' kalıbıdır.

basics_en_used_to.prompt: She is a night nurse, so she is used to ___ during the night.
basics_en_used_to.why: 'Be used to' yapısından sonra fiil gerund (-ing) halinde gelir: is used to working.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: By the time the fire brigade arrived, the neighbours ___ put out the flames.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Geçmişteki bir andan ('by the time they arrived') önce tamamlanmış eylem için Past Perfect: had already put out.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: When I opened my bag at the checkout, I realized I ___ my wallet at home.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Cüzdanı evde unutma eylemi fark etme anından da önce gerçekleşmiştir: had left.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: She had never ___ abroad before her trip to Italy last year.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Past Perfect yapısında had'den sonra fiilin 3. hali gelir: had never travelled.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: After they ___ dinner, they went for a pleasant stroll along the beach.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Önce tamamlanan geçmiş eylem için Past Perfect kullanılır: after they had finished.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: The train had already ___ when we reached the platform.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Gara varıştan önce trenin gitmiş olması Past Perfect'tir: had already departed.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: He was very nervous during the flight because he ___ flown in an airplane before.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Uçuştan önceki hayat deneyimsizliği için 'hadn't flown' kullanılır.

basics_en_past_perfect.prompt: They didn't recognize the village because it ___ so much over thirty years.
basics_en_past_perfect.why: Tanımama anından önceki değişim süreci Past Perfect ile verilir: had changed.

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: You haven't seen my keys anywhere, ___ you?
basics_en_question_tags.why: Ana cümle olumsuz (haven't seen) olduğunda question tag olumlu olur: have you?

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: She lives in central London, ___ she?
basics_en_question_tags.why: Ana cümle Present Simple olumlu 3. tekil şahıs olduğunda tag 'doesn't she?'dir.

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: Let's take a short break now, ___ we?
basics_en_question_tags.why: 'Let's' ile başlayan teklif cümlelerinin question tag'i standart olarak 'shall we?'dir.

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: I am late for the meeting, ___ I?
basics_en_question_tags.why: 'I am' ifadesinin soru eki istisnai olarak 'aren't I?' biçimindedir.

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: Everybody enjoyed the party last night, ___ they?
basics_en_question_tags.why: 'Everybody' zamiri question tag'de 'they' zamirine dönüşür; Past Simple olumlu için: didn't they?

basics_en_question_tags.prompt: They won't be late for the ceremony, ___ they?

basics_en_question_tags.why: Olumsuz emir cümlelerinde soru eki 'will you?' kalıbıdır.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: How long have you been ___ English at this language academy?
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Present Perfect Continuous yapısında 'have you been + V-ing' kalıbı kullanılır: been learning.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: The ground is completely wet outside; it has been ___ all morning.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Etkisi şu an gözle görülen süregelen geçmiş eylem için: has been raining.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: I am exhausted because I have been ___ in the garden for five hours.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Yorgunluğun sebebini açıklayan devam eden süreç: have been digging.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: She has been working on this design project ___ last October.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Başlangıç tarihi (last October) belirtilirken 'since' edatı kullanılır.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: They have been living in this flat ___ three years now.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Zaman süresinin miktarı (üç yıldır) 'for' ile verilir: for three years.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: Why are your clothes covered in flour? - I have been ___ a birthday cake.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: Üst başın unlu olmasının nedeni devam eden eylemdir: have been baking.

basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.prompt: He ___ been waiting for the bus for over forty minutes.
basics_en_present_perfect_continuous.why: 3. tekil şahıs (He) için Present Perfect yardımcı fiili 'has'dir: He has been waiting.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: At this exact time tomorrow afternoon, we ___ across the Atlantic Ocean.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: Gelecekte belirli bir anda devam ediyor olacak eylemler Future Continuous (will be + V-ing) ile anlatılır.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: Don't phone me between seven and eight tonight; I ___ dinner with my family.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: O saat aralığında sürüyor olacak eylem: will be having dinner.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: This time next week, she ___ on a sunny beach in Hawaii.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: 'This time next week' Future Continuous gerektiren tipik zaman ifadesidir: will be lying.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: Will you be ___ the car tonight, or can I borrow it?
basics_en_future_continuous.why: Kibarca birinin planını öğrenmek için Future Continuous soru biçimi kullanılır: Will you be using...?

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: At ten o'clock tomorrow, the students ___ their final English exam.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: Belirli saatte sürüyor olacak sınav eylemi: will be taking.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: He won't be ___ the conference next Tuesday because he is ill.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: Gelecekteki olumsuz devamlılık: won't be attending.

basics_en_future_continuous.prompt: Tomorrow morning I will be ___ with the chief executive officer.
basics_en_future_continuous.why: Future Continuous yapısı 'will be + meeting' şeklindedir.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: Jack broke his arm in an accident and had to stay in ___ for three days.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Hasta olarak tedavi görmek amacıyla bulunulduğunda İngiliz İngilizcesinde artikelsiz 'in hospital' denir.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: My mother went to ___ hospital to visit her sick colleague.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Hastaneye hasta olarak değil, ziyaretçi olarak gidildiğinde bina belirli artikel alır: went to the hospital.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: Children in Britain usually start ___ school at the age of five.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Öğrenci olarak okula gitmek kurumun asıl amacıdır ve artikelsizdir: start school.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: The criminal was found guilty and sent to ___ prison for ten years.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Mahkûm olarak cezaevine gönderilmek 'sent to prison' şeklinde artikelsiz kullanılır.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: I am feeling extremely tired; I think I will go to ___ bed now.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Uyumak amacıyla yatağa gitmek kalıbı artikelsiz 'go to bed'dir.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: Many young adults leave home when they go to ___ university.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Eğitim almak amacıyla üniversiteye gitmek 'go to university' olarak artikelsiz söylenir.

basics_en_articles_institutions.prompt: The social worker went to ___ prison to interview the inmate.
basics_en_articles_institutions.why: Cezaevine mahkûm olarak değil, görevli/ziyaretçi olarak gidildiğinde 'the prison' denir.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: My car was making a strange noise, so I had it ___ by a certified mechanic.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Have something done' ettirgen yapısında nesneden sonra fiilin 3. hali (V3) gelir: had it repaired.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: I will get my assistant ___ you all the necessary meeting documents.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Get someone to do something' yapısında fiil 'to + infinitive' alır: get my assistant to send.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: The teacher made the students ___ the entire essay from beginning to end.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Make someone do something' (zorlamak) ettirgen yapısında fiil yalın halde (bare infinitive) kalır: made them rewrite.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: Her parents wouldn't let her ___ to the late-night rock festival.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Let someone do something' (izin vermek) yapısında fiil yalın gelir: let her go.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: She had the photographer ___ professional portraits for her website.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Have someone do something' yapısında kişi geldiğinde fiil yalındır: had the photographer take.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: How often do you have your teeth ___ by a dentist?
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Have your teeth checked' (dişlerini kontrol ettirmek) edilgen ettirgen yapıdır.

basics_en_causatives_advanced.prompt: I managed to get the technician ___ my broken laptop within two hours.
basics_en_causatives_advanced.why: 'Get + kişi + to + infinitive' ikna ve yaptırma kalıbıdır: get the technician to fix.

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: The film was ___ exciting that the audience clapped at the end.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: Sıfattan hemen önce gelip 'that' ile bağlanan derece zarfı 'so'dur: so exciting that...

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: It was ___ a wonderful sunny day that we decided to go sailing.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: 'a/an + sıfat + isim' öncesinde 'such' kullanılır: such a wonderful day that...

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: This coffee is ___ hot to drink right now; please wait a few minutes.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: Aşırılık ve olumsuz sonuç bildiren kalıp 'too + sıfat + to + mastar'dır: too hot to drink.

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: He is not old ___ to obtain a driving licence in this country.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: 'Enough' sıfat ve zarflardan SONRA gelir: old enough to obtain.

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: They had ___ delicious food at the banquet that everyone overate.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: Sayılamayan veya çoğul isim tamlamaları önünde 'such' kullanılır: such delicious food.

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: She ran ___ fast that nobody could catch up with her.
basics_en_so_such_too_enough.why: Zarftan (fast) önce 'so' kullanılır: so fast that...

basics_en_so_such_too_enough.prompt: We don't have ___ money to buy that luxury sports car.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: Could you please tell me where the nearest post office ___ ?
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Dolaylı sorularda soru dizilimi kalkar ve özne fiilden önce gelir (düz cümle dizilimi): where the post office is.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: Do you know what time the supermarket ___ in the evening?
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Dolaylı soru içinde 'does' yardımcı fiili kullanılmaz; fiil özneye uyar: what time the supermarket closes.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: I wonder if she ___ coming to the staff meeting today.
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Evet/hayır dolaylı sorusunda 'if + özne + fiil' dizilimi kurulur: if she is coming.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: Can you explain how this complicated machine ___ ?
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Dolaylı soruda düz sıra kullanılır: how this machine works.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: I'd like to know how much this leather jacket ___ , please.
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Dolaylı soruda fiyat sorgusu düz cümledir: how much this jacket costs.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: Do you have any idea where they ___ their summer holiday this year?
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: Geçmiş zaman dolaylı sorusunda 'did' atılır ve fiil V2 olur: where they spent.

basics_en_indirect_questions.prompt: Could you let me know whether the train ___ on platform four?
basics_en_indirect_questions.why: 'Whether + özne + fiil' düz dizilimi: whether the train arrives.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: The lecture on modern astrophysics was so ___ that half the students fell asleep.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Bir nesnenin/durumun özelliğini anlatan sıfat -ing alır: the lecture was boring.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: I was completely ___ during the long and repetitive speech.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Kişinin hissettiği duyguyu belirten sıfat -ed alır: I was bored.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: She bought a ___ wooden dining table for her new apartment.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: OSASCOMP sıfat dizilimi kuralına göre: Opinion (beautiful) + Age (old) + Shape (round) gelir.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: He was very ___ to hear that his team had won the championship.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Kişinin hissettiği heyecan duygusu -ed alır: he was excited.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: Climbing Mount Everest must be an incredibly ___ experience.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Deneyimin yorucu niteliği -ing ile nitelenir: an exhausting experience.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: She wore an elegant ___ dress to the gala dinner.
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Sıfat sırası: Size (long) + Colour (black) + Material (silk): a long black silk dress.

basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.prompt: Are you ___ in joining our university drama club this term?
basics_en_adjective_order_ed_ing.why: Kişinin ilgi duyması 'interested in' kalıbıdır (-ed alır).
